description:
**Description**
 As Principal Engineer for Delivery Choices in Hyderabad, you'll own the technical foundation for Add to Delivery, our fastest\-growing customer experience that delivered $billions incremental OPS in 2025 and is expanding to nine countries in 2026\. This isn't about optimizing existing systems—it's about architecting delivery\-building behavior that fundamentally changes how 200\+ million Prime members shop.
   

  

 In a team that sits between core Amazon operations and core Amazon retail organizations, this is a unique role with enormous breath of influence and ownership. You'll work at the intersection of customer experience, fulfillment networks, and international expansion, coordinating architectural decisions across 30\+ partner organizations (SCOT, P13N, CPX, EUIC, Search, Promise, Shipping, GDCX) while your team operates at maximum parallelization. Your Hyderabad team owns systems spanning international AtD expansion to nine countries (representing large OPS impact and ship cost savings), Core DC precision products across 18\+ markets, and foundational services requiring Tier\-1 migration.
   

  

 What Makes This Different
   

  

 You're not solving scale or latency—you're solving architectural coherence across organizational and geographic boundaries during a high\-velocity scaling phase.
   

  

 You'll have principal\-level authority to drive real\-time architectural decisions. This is influencer and integrator work—shaping technical direction across teams you don't control, building consensus across distributed ownership, and ensuring our international expansion maintains architectural consistency while moving at maximum velocity.
   

  

 You're solving architectural coherence across organizational and geographic boundaries during a high\-velocity scaling phase. The technical challenges are specific: redesigning Buy\-X\-Get\-Y promotions architecture to work across multiple purchase sessions, evolving Add to Delivery personalization to remove post\-filtering from the CX layer in under XXms, partnering with Fulfillment Optimization and Search teams to recover XXXms of latency in Search Gateway, extending Amazon Day and other consolidation products to pre\-checkout surfaces, and re\-architecting checkout flows with the Purchase Experience team.
   

  

 Required Domain Expertise
   

  

 This role requires experience with broad design systems and cross\-organizational technical coordination at scale. As an ideal candidate, you will already have experience in e\-commerce delivery systems architecture. When fully ramped you will need deep understanding of Amazon's delivery promise systems—how systems like Promise, and Fulfillment Optimization interact to calculate, align, and fulfill delivery dates across multiple fulfillment networks. This includes expertise in promise matching, promise alignment, eligibility evaluation, and the technical mechanisms that enable consolidation across orders.
   

  

 Beyond technical depth, this role demands expertise in architectural coordination across 30\+ partner organizations where you must influence design decisions without direct authority. You'll navigate country\-specific legal requirements (EU payment regulations, MFA constraints in India), marketplace\-specific fulfillment characteristics, and localized promise behaviors while maintaining architectural consistency.
   

  

 While in role you must also understand international expansion complexity: configuration management across 27 services, promise accuracy requirements varying by locale, and the technical debt patterns that compound across markets. This isn't generic distributed systems work—it's delivery\-domain\-specific architecture requiring fluency in how customers shop, how promises are calculated, and how consolidation creates network value.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Delivery Choices supports customers' unique needs for shopping convenience defined as greater consolidation, predictability, and control over delivery timelines. We enable customers to easily add items to an upcoming delivery at any point during their shopping journey, and provide delivery options that offer customers additional benefits like increased control over delivery timelines, lower carbon delivery, and monetary rewards.

* 12\+ years of professional software development experience
* 7\+ years programming experience with at least one software programming language
* 5\+ years experience contributing to the system design or architecture (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead OR leading an engineering team


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Ability to take raw product requirements and develop software architectures and designs to bring them to life
* Analytical abilities, proven design skills and a track record of delivery
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
* Hands\-on expertise in many disparate technologies, typically ranging from front\-end user interfaces through to back\-end systems and all points in between
* Experience in driving systemic operational improvements
* Experience mentoring software engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
* Experience influencing software engineers best practices across teams
* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Master's degree in computer science or related technical discipline, or equivalent experience
* Experience with or knowledge of AWS services
* Deep understanding of e\-commerce delivery systems, promise calculation, and fulfillment optimization
* Experience coordinating architecture across multiple organizations without direct authority

 WW R\&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. Our goal is to achieve the three zeroes: zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects. We do this by developing innovative products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long\-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re\-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon \- returns, recommerce, and rentals.
   

  

 Amazon WW R\&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re\-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world\-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a member of this team, your mission will be to design, develop, document and support massively scalable, distributed real time systems. Using Java, object oriented design patterns, distributed databases and other innovative storage techniques, you will build and deliver software systems that support complex and rapidly evolving business requirements.

They will get to work on some of the key initiatives planned to support our rapid evolution and growth and in the process solve some of the most challenging problems. These engineers will provide the technical leadership to the team, drive best practices, mentor other engineers and drive continuous improvements in engineering excellence.
   

  

 We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work\-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
